title: Microsoft Edge: Expanded enforcement controls for Data Loss Prevention connectors
description: Microsoft Edge for Business is expanding its existing Data Loss Prevention Enterprise Connector capabilities. Administrators will be able to configure more consistent enforcement across download, upload, paste, and print workflows. Additional controls include required bypass justification and administrator-defined guidance.
